visibleEditorialCopy.curiosityHook: When the patriotic ideals he fought for collapse upon his return home, how does one veteran channel deep betrayal into national defiance?
visibleEditorialCopy.description: Paralyzed during the Vietnam War, Ron Kovic returns home to face profound physical trauma, rising disillusionment, and a nation that leaves him feeling betrayed by the cause he served.
visibleEditorialCopy.vibeSummary: Heavy, thoughtful, and deliberately paced, offering an emotionally demanding drama best experienced with focused attention.
visibleEditorialCopy.whyWatch: Oliver Stone directs a weighty biographical drama that transforms personal sacrifice and wartime trauma into a passionate awakening for civil rights and peace.
